paper_title: Impact of Fecal Microbiota Transplantation on Gut Bacterial Bile Acid Metabolism in Humans
skip_reason: This paper is a treatment intervention study (FMT vs. placebo) in obese but metabolically healthy patients. There is no disease group compared against a healthy control. All participants are obese and metabolically normal at baseline (no T2DM, no metabolic syndrome, no NAFLD); the study design compares FMT-treated vs. placebo-treated arms, not a disease cohort vs. healthy control cohort. The qualification gate requires a disease group vs. healthy control comparison, which this study does not have.
